summary: Plan grill of FORGE-ACC-3 (approval + closeout integrity), re-authored off main @8f1d053 after CFS-1 merged. Three findings resolved: closeout order kept verify->review (no flip), task 6 stays one task (split on budget signal), first-new-layout coupling is a dogfooding feature routed through evidence_path; task 2 expanded to a per-task plan-mode-approval gate (operator-required, Codex-designed).
current_flow: ACC-1/ACC-2 shipped the loop's front half (skeletal frontier, proof-carrying grills, derived grounding, budgets). Approval and closeout remain convention: approved plans re-legitimize on re-record, task approval is implicit chat, no pre-draft requirements round, per-stage local review gates nothing, stage done accepts uncommitted work, review lenses need not be one run, closeout artifacts record in any order, windows can open mid-stage. check_encoding_hygiene still pins by file:line (fragile - CFS-1's CI fix added more line pins).

Expanded task 2 into a per-task-plan-approval gate per Codex's minimal design (2026-08-19): per-task plan at .factory/stories/<KEY>/task-plans/<id>.md (evidence_path); forge task plan save + forge task approve bind plan_digest_without_assumptions + stamp approved_by/at into the grill record; require_ready_task refuses at stage start AND delegate until BOTH the grill passed AND a matching approval exists; task_frontier_state routes author-contract -> grill -> author-task-plan -> await-approval -> stage-start -> delegate; NO grounding_digest change (grill precedes plan). Audited human attestation per 0029 - no false crypto claim, no signing/daemon (over-building). Operator-required + Codex-validated.
